items.title: Kane set to miss three months with ankle injury
items.excerpt: Harry Kane is expected to be sidelined for three months after suffering an ankle injury during Bayern Munich's Bundesliga game with Cologne on Friday.
body: Harry Kane is expected to be sidelined for three months after suffering an ankle injury during Bayern Munich's Bundesliga game with Cologne on Friday.
Sky Germany report Bayern sporting director Max Eberl confirmed shortly after the 1-1 draw that Kane had suffered a "syndesmosis ligament tear" - also known as a high ankle sprain.

The Ballon d'Or winner - who became England's most-capped player last week - was seeking a first goal in five matches for the Bundesliga leaders. items.title: Van Dijk uncertain on Liverpool future
items.excerpt: Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk believes he can keeping playing for "many more years" - but says he does not yet know whether that will be at Anfield next season.
body: Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk believes he can keeping playing for "many more years" - but says he does not yet know whether that will be at Anfield next season.
The 35-year-old centre-back, who has won two Premier League titles and the Champions League during his time at Liverpool, is out of contract in the summer.
He told Sky Sports that, currently, he is uncertain on what will happen beyond this campaign.
"The main thing for me is that I feel good and I'm looking after myself and I still have many more years in my opinion," he said.

items.title: Drones, data and Bruno - Pochettino on his early Man Utd challenges
items.excerpt: Mauricio Pochettino has questioned what could have been gained from the drone footage of a Manchester United training session ahead of his first game in charge against Liverpool.
body: Mauricio Pochettino has questioned what could have been gained from the drone footage of a Manchester United training session ahead of his first game in charge against Liverpool.

A 12-minute video taken over United's Carrington training ground showed the Argentine overseeing various tactical drills with his new team as they prepared for a trip to Anfield on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.

The operator has since apologised and taken down the video, but footage has been viewed over eight million times on reposts from other X accounts and has since been reuploaded by several other YouTube channels, collectively attracting hundreds of thousands of views.

Sky Sports News understands the club do not plan on taking legal action, but will not rule out doing so in the future if further incidents occur, and Pochettino questioned the motivation behind the filming.

items.title: Inquest into death of Sheffield United Cusack to resume next month
items.excerpt: An inquest into the death of Sheffield United midfielder Maddy Cusack will resume next month after there was a delay to obtain more information about her time at the club.
body: An inquest into the death of Sheffield United midfielder Maddy Cusack will resume next month after there was a delay to obtain more information about her time at the club.
Cusack's family sent a written complaint to United within a week after she died, outlining issues they alleged stemmed from her time working under her coach Jonathan Morgan.

The 27-year-old was found unresponsive at her home in Horsley, Derbyshire, on September 20 2023, after Morgan made comments about her weight and relationship with another player, Chesterfield Coroner's Court heard.

Assistant coroner Sophie Cartwright KC heard eight days of evidence from Morgan, Cusack's parents, her former team-mates, and members of staff from United, before the inquest was adjourned in July to get more evidence from the club.
